author: A skald of Dawnstar
pages:
~They say the brave walk a whalebone bridge
~to a hall where the mead is warm,
~where the feast goes on past the world's last ridge
~and no one fears the storm.

~But I have dreamed of a mist that eats,
~that hunts the newly dead,
~a black wing over the hall's long seats
~and a silence where songs were said.

~If someone hears this and has the Voice,
~go up where the old ones went.
~The dead of Skyrim have no choice.
~You do. Be what you are meant.
